checks.text: All external bleeding stopped within 2 minutes
checks.why: Fragments leave several bleeding wounds on different limbs. Check every body part and stop each bleed.

checks.requiresText: No fracture of that limb in this variation
checks.why: Inspect for deformity and splint the fractured limb (a medic realigns it first so the splint sets the bone).
Fragment wounds and fractures hurt; treat pain once bleeding is controlled.

checks.requiresText: No chest injury in this variation
checks.why: A penetrating torso wound causes a chest injury; seal it so a pneumothorax cannot build up.
